name: Cloudflare AI Gateway Provider
description: Routes the Drupal AI module through a Cloudflare AI Gateway, exposing every model the gateway fronts through one provider.
project_description: A single Drupal AI provider that routes the AI module through a Cloudflare AI Gateway, so every model the gateway fronts (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Mistral, Workers AI and more) is reachable through one connection with the gateway's caching, request logging and cost analytics. It extends the AI module's OpenAI-compatible provider base and re-points it at the gateway's /compat endpoint, adding the cf-aig-* control headers (cache TTL, skip-cache, metadata). Upstream provider keys live in the gateway (unified billing or bring-your-own-key), and Cloudflare account credentials come from the sibling cloudflare_ai/cloudflare_sdk modules (settings.php), so no provider key is stored in Drupal configuration. Supports chat (including streamed responses) and embeddings, a live model-catalogue picker with per-provider filtering and price display, and Cloudflare Dynamic Routing routes referenced as dynamic/<route>. Configuration and the model autocomplete are gated behind the 'administer ai providers' permission.
